description: osirAppGetSource: Get a deployed Osir app's current source, to make edits without the user re-attaching the project. With inline=true it returns the files themselves: patch them and call osirAppDeploy with ALL the files under the SAME name; the platform rebuilds and, for owned-tier apps, auto-ships the new version to the user's box. If the result says truncated=true the files are only PART of the app - do NOT redeploy from them. Without inline it returns only a short-lived signed zip URL (getUrl), useful only to a client with a shell. Requires authentication.

appName.description: The deployed app's name, as shown by osirAppList.

inline.description: true (recommended): return the files themselves (up to 300 files / 2 MiB). false/omitted: only a signed zip URL.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: osirAppGetSource
